title: Power Pages: performance and usage metrics in the Power Platform admin center monitor hub
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, admin paths and general Monitor prerequisites are supported, and its Power Pages-specific documentation gaps were confirmed by targeted searches. One minor correction should acknowledge that Microsoft's draft export documentation describes a 30-day window, whereas the cited Monitor overview states 28 days.
